requirement: All required module, summary, reference, and intermediate directories exist
Published manifest sample IDs equal supplied manifest and metadata IDs
rationale: Detects dropped, duplicated, or mismatched samples

requirement: Every supplied contaminant and mitochondrial truth feature is identified and absent from the final microbial table
rationale: Validates local BLAST and non-target filtering

requirement: At least one microbial ASV receives a non-empty taxonomy assignment
At least one FDR-significant Type_Group or Case indicator matches an implanted group-effect ASV
rationale: Demonstrates recovery of known group structure

requirement: At least one implanted positive ASV-VOC pair is recovered with rho >= 0.30
The inferred graph has at least 10 edges, a multi-node module, and at least three edges within implanted modules
rationale: Rejects an uninformative or truth-discordant network

requirement: Topology node/edge counts agree with the inferred graph and the configured degree-preserving null ensemble completes
rationale: Exercises the SPARK supplementary network topology and null-model analysis

requirement: Every benchmarked plot-producing module emits at least one SVG
Every module file listed in module_output_manifest.tsv exists and matches its SHA-256
rationale: Detects incomplete or altered publication outputs

requirement: Airways/Oral pass biological depth QC; Skin is BIO and blanks are TECH, with no control depth cutoff
rationale: Validates the sample design and independent prevalence cohorts

requirement: Cleaned counts equal raw QC biological counts after TECH/BIO union removal, with complete reason codes
rationale: Detects changed retained counts, misclassified controls and incorrect feature removal

requirement: Final microbial table is a count-preserving subset of cleaned biological counts and matches final FASTA
rationale: Validates both feature-filtering layers and sequence synchronization

requirement: ASV feature audit matches nonzero prevalence and independent per-sample RA in biological inputs
rationale: Controls excluded from denominators; both configured gates must pass
